document_status: Proposed research decisions for supervisor review, not implemented Phase 3 features

current_phase2_graph.representation: Undirected NetworkX Graph with physical connectivity; edges do not simulate packets, tunnels or switching
current_phase2_graph.ring_membership: One physical link can belong to two rings; capacity is stored once
current_phase2_graph.shared_main_sub_link_capacity: Existing main-ring link keeps 10,000 Mb/s if it is also used by a sub-ring
current_phase2_graph.initial_reservations: 0 Mb/s on every edge; Phase 2 never admits service requests
current_phase2_graph.gateway_model: Single/dual node shared membership and adjacent physical link; not evidence of a specific operator installation
current_phase2_graph.failure_testing: Exhaustive deletion of each one physical edge or one physical node, with graph-connectedness recomputed

phase3_proposed_capacity_semantics.rationale: Define one direction-specific capacity ledger per physical full-duplex link. Keep one physical link id, with separate u->v and v->u counters. Must be approved before implementing admission.
phase3_proposed_capacity_semantics.shared_physical_link: One physical resource with independent direction ledgers; a multi-ring edge is not counted twice due to ring labels
phase3_proposed_capacity_semantics.symmetric_service_reservation: Undecided: decide if each service reserves equal rates in both directions or an explicitly asymmetric demand vector
phase3_proposed_capacity_semantics.failure_state_budget: Explicit post-fault forwarding must be defined before adding loads, with all selected single-link failures tested

phase3_protection_decision_needed.choice_A: Implement and validate explicit RFC 8227/ITU G.8132 shared-ring tunnel and selected protection-switching semantics (complex).
phase3_protection_decision_needed.choice_B: Implement a simplified precomputed link-fault reroute abstraction using ordered ring arcs; label only as a surrogate, not as MSRP-compliant switching.
phase3_protection_decision_needed.suggested_first_step: Document a single deterministic switching rule for ring segments and gateway stitching, or select the simplified surrogate with explicit limitations. Supervisor review is required.
never_claim: guaranteed protected service admission from graph connectivity

ethics_and_scope.industry_evidence: Do not infer vendor features or actual deployment shape from this model
